page.title: Enterprise PMO & Portfolio Governance Hub
page.welcome:
Enterprise PMO & Governance Hub

Strategic alignment, risk assurance and data-driven execution

The control centre for the enterprise transformation programme: initiative health, overdue escalations, the decisions the Executive Board owes, and early warnings across every workstream. Each panel below is a live view of a PMO list; open it to work the items.
page.commentary:
PMO executive commentary

Updated by the PMO before each Steering Committee. Edit this text part directly; keep it to what the Board must know or do.

Current governance focus: [portfolio RAG split from the scorecard, e.g. x% Green / y% Amber / z% Red] and [the headline focus this period].

Primary escalations:

  • [Workstream]: [issue, impact and the intervention needed]
  • [Workstream]: [issue, impact and the intervention needed]

Required executive actions:

  1. Review and decide [CR reference] before [forum and date].
  2. Sign off the pending decisions in the panel below.
page.powerBiNote: Power BI: Portfolio RAG scorecard, milestone slippage trend and early-warning heatmap from the PMO Enterprise Analytics workspace. Pick the report in this web part's settings. Viewers need a Power BI licence or the workspace on Premium/Fabric capacity.
